description: PVForecast, published by StefaE, creates photovoltaic production forecasts from weather and external forecast services, with optional European electricity-price and carbon-intensity forecasts. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is GPL-3.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: External providers have separate access limits; the README documents breaking configuration changes between versions. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
